problem: A,B,C,D = construct_square_q(80), E = construct_on_pline(A,B,D), F = construct_angle_clockwise(A,D,pi/12)
necessary_constructions: A,B,C,D = construct_square_q(80), E = construct_on_pline(A,B,D), F = construct_angle_clockwise(A,D,pi/12)
proof:
Solution:
1. Square(A,B,C,D) => Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) & Angle_A_D_B - Angle_C_A_D
2. Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) & Parallel(A,E,B,D) => Perpendicular(A,C,A,E)
3. Perpendicular(A,C,A,E) => Angle_C_A_E - pi/2
4. Perpendicular(A,C,B,D) => Angle_A_D_B + Angle_C_A_D - pi/2
5. Angle_C_A_E - pi/2 & Angle_C_A_E - Angle_C_A_F - Angle_E_A_F & Angle_D_A_F - pi/12 & Angle_A_E_F + Angle_A_F_E + Angle_E_A_F - pi & Angle_A_D_B + Angle_C_A_D - pi/2 & Angle_A_D_B - Angle_C_A_D & Angle_C_A_D - Angle_C_A_F - Angle_D_A_F => Angle_A_E_F + Angle_A_F_E - 2*pi/3
6. Angle_A_E_F + Angle_A_F_E - 2*pi/3 & Angle_A_E_F + Angle_A_F_E + Angle_E_A_F - pi => Angle_E_A_F - pi/3
